target_customer: Industrial operations and HR teams at manufacturers
problem: Frontline manufacturing workers get inconsistent on-the-job training and safety and quality procedures, which hurts production efficiency.
business_model: B2B SaaS for industrial training and quality management
product_category: Frontline worker training and quality software

founders.name: Arjun Patel
founders.background_notes: Later listed as an investor at Ex Machina Ventures per the YC page.

founders.name: Richard Girges
founders.background_notes: Later CTO at MNTN per the YC page.

founders.name: Bryan Trang
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; a newsletter profile calls him CPO.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile and web app for training content, procedures and performance tracking; standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Training content and procedure software is easy to copy, and the main differentiation was focus on industrial frontline workers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC page lists the company as acquired; the acquirer could not be verified.

market_need_then: The company's seed announcement says it surveyed 124 manufacturers about training needs; dated 2019 evidence beyond that was not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Some coverage from a seed raise and a founder newsletter interview, but no brand assets or community evidence were found.

outcome_analysis: WorkClout built industrial training and quality software, raised a US$2.3M seed in April 2020 and is listed by YC as acquired. The acquirer, date and price could not be verified, so it is unknown whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing; one aggregator names Luxury Presence in January 2022, which looks implausible for an industrial software company.
notes: The company site workclout.com returned HTTP 503. Seed of US$2.3M in April 2020 is confirmed by the Pulse 2.0 article (opened) and a Business Insider India headline in search results. A US$150K 2019 pre-seed appears only in aggregators and is unrecorded. The acquirer Luxury Presence in January 2022 comes from a single CB Insights snippet and is unverified, so exit acquirer and date are null. Founding year 2018 comes from an aggregator; the YC page does not state it. Founder education and prior employers were not found. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found.
